page.overview:
What is The LEGO Batman Movie?

The LEGO Batman Movie is a theme for The LEGO Batman Movie, released in several waves through 2016 and 2018.

Lego has revealed there will be at least 13 sets released for the movie as of the first half of 2017. Some sets were revealed through articles on websites such as Entertainment Weekly and The Wall Street Journal, among others.
